independent_thermal_comparison.reference_method: SciPy Radau integration and independent shooting closure
independent_thermal_comparison.provenance: Original GearForge thermal topology, inputs and reference adapter. Separate direct heat-flow ODE; no GearForge matrices, modes or root isolator in the reference process.
independent_thermal_comparison.scope: Temperatures at display/critical times and generated, rejected and stored energy for entered and independently solved periodic cycles in eight original networks. No physical loss, cooling or material qualification.

limitations: Passive isothermal bodies with piecewise-constant capacities/conductances/heat inputs only; actual loss maps and cooling coefficients are not supplied.
Original synthetic fixtures are numerical examples, not measured material, lubricant or gearbox data.
The independent ODE reference verifies numerical temperature/energy behavior for declared networks, not physical thermal qualification.
Repeated-cycle equilibrium is distinct from transient warm-up. Conservative all-cycle bounds can exceed a limit without proving an actual crossing.
Nonlinear radiation/losses, spatial hot spots, lubricant film, actual material data, tooth-root/transient fatigue, manufacturing and physical assembly qualification remain.
Unsigned native packages require acceptance on actual company workstation images.
